title: An alignment guide on the canvas says which edges it checked
goal: A guide reads aligned or off 4 px on the canvas, but only the inspector says whether it checked left edges, tops or centers. Anyone reading the exported picture cannot tell. The guide chip should name its edge, so the picture stands on its own.
notes: From audit 2026-09-02-alignment-guide-row rough 4 (the settled edge is a readout in the inspector only). Code: MeasureContent.label for alignment verdicts at Sources/PhotonzCore/Measure.swift:325 (aligned / off N px), the edge word already derived for the row in MeasureSpecList.derivedName and AlignmentCheck side inference (ink within 20 px). MeasureLabelPlacement.plan uses estimatedLabelSize, so the wider chip changes candidates; MeasureRasterizer bakes it. Keep the spec line format pinned by MeasureSpecListTests unchanged.
acceptance: In the Next release with next-measure-align on: draw a guide along the left edges of three stacked elements and the chip reads Left edges aligned; nudge one element in a test fixture and the chip reads Left edges, off 4 px.
When the scan cannot tell the side, the chip reads Vertical edges or Horizontal edges, matching the row name in the Measurements list.
The longer chip still finds a clear spot: the readout planner uses the new width, checked by the existing placement tests plus one for a guide near the picture edge.
Exports bake the new wording; spec lines are unchanged; Scripts/test.sh green; audit written under queue/audits/ with a rendered before and after; anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task.

log.note: Pre-build review. (1) The canvas chip is the only thing an exported picture carries, and today it reads aligned / off 4 px with no subject: a reader cannot tell left edges from tops from centers. The row name in the panel already has the words (Left edges / Vertical edges), so the chip reuses them: Left edges aligned, Left edges, off 4 px. (2) Shortest version: change the baked chip text only. The spec line, the panel row (name already says the edge) and the inspector stay as they are. (3) Breaking it: the chip gets about 2.5x wider. A guide down the left edges of a card sits near the picture edge, and the chip is centred on the guide, so a 240 px chip centred at x 96 hangs off the picture. The planner already penalises off-canvas but has no move that fixes it for the past-the-end spots (its only cross-axis move is the sideways placement, which lands on the rows). So the planner needs to let a past-the-end or on-line chip slide across the line just far enough to stay on the picture. (4) No verdict (fewer than two edges) has no edge to name: the chip reads No edges, capitalised to match the new sentences. (5) Not a decision for the user: wording follows the row names the previous audit already settled, so no card.

Built and verified. MeasureContent.chipText names the edge (Left edges aligned / Left edges, off 4 px / Vertical edges when the side is unknown / No edges); MeasureContent.alignmentEdgesPhrase is shared with MeasureSpecList.derivedName so row and chip never disagree; label() and the spec line are unchanged. estimatedLabelSize for a guide is sized from measured SF Pro widths (0.44 em + 1.2 px per glyph, line box 1.2 em + 5), pinned against the real pill by AlignmentChipTests at every label size. MeasureLabelPlanner lets a past-the-end chip slide across the guide by exactly its overhang to stay on the picture (stored in labelCrossReach; on-line chips stay centred so the dashes never show through the fill). MeasureRasterizer bakes chipText. Scripts/test.sh: 1248 tests green (13 new). Before/after renders through DocumentRenderer on the audit capture in queue/audits/2026-09-02-guide-edge-chip-*.png; audit at queue/audits/2026-09-02-guide-edge-chip.json. Could not click through the app (no screen capture for the loop), so acceptance item 1 is verified on the fixture through the same render pipeline rather than by hand.

Post-build review: the chip is about twice as wide, so on pictures under ~300 px a left-edge guide may have no spot both on the picture and off its rows (planner then covers a row rather than fall off). Filed follow-ups: caliper pill reserved height 2 px short of the real pill (shared code, left alone), and the button-tops guide reading off 1 px with 4 items on the 2x capture (scan tolerance).

Guide chip now reads Left edges aligned / Left edges, off 4 px (or Vertical edges when the side is unknown); reservation sized to the real text; a wide chip near the picture edge slides onto the picture. Sources/PhotonzCore/Measure.swift, MeasureLabelPlacement.swift, MeasureSpecList.swift, PhotonzRender/MeasureRasterizer.swift. 1248 tests green; renders in queue/audits/2026-09-02-guide-edge-chip-*.png; audit written.
